items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Binnen zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung dieses Bescheids kann Einspruch eingelegt werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Stadt Musterhomburg (Saar) – Ordnungsbehörde.
items.computation: The letter was formally served (förmliche Zustellung via Postzustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO), with the delivery day entered by the postal carrier on the return slip as 24.11.2026 ('zugestellt' 24.11.2026). For this kind of formal service there is no statutory deemed-delivery fiction; the actual date noted on the Zustellungsurkunde is the anchor. Zustellung is an event, so under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery (24.11.2026, Tuesday) itself is not counted; the two-week period starts 25.11.2026. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, two weeks later (counting from 24.11.) ends on 08.12.2026 (Tuesday). 08.12.2026 is a normal working day in Saarland (not a weekend or holiday), so no shift applies. Deadline: 08.12.2026.

items.title: Pay the total fine (Geldbuße, Gebühr, Auslagen) after the decision becomes final
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Gesamtbetrag erst nach Rechtskraft, und zwar innerhalb von zwei Wochen.
items.computation: The letter instructs payment only after Rechtskraft (the decision becoming final), within two weeks of that event. Rechtskraft occurs once the two-week Einspruch period has run without an objection, i.e. the day after 08.12.2026, so 09.12.2026. Treating Rechtskraft as the triggering event, under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB that day itself is not counted; the two-week payment period starts 10.12.2026 and, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, ends two weeks after 09.12.2026 on 23.12.2026 (Wednesday), a normal working day in Saarland (no shift needed). This assumes no Einspruch is filed; filing one would suspend Rechtskraft and this payment schedule.

warnings: The Einspruch and payment deadlines rely on the delivery date (24.11.2026) handwritten on the attached Zustellungsurkunde copy; if the actual service date recorded by the postal carrier differs, both deadlines shift accordingly — check the original return receipt or confirm with the Bußgeldstelle.
The payment deadline (23.12.2026) only applies if no Einspruch is filed by 08.12.2026; filing an objection suspends Rechtskraft and this payment obligation.
